answer: Every claim climbs the velvet of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the echo re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, split across independent auditors, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Reaching the timber of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
